titles: 비 오기 전날 무릎이 먼저 쑤시는 이유
thumbnail_texts: 비 때문이 아니었다 / 비 오면 쑤시는 무릎
빗물은 상관없었다 / 무릎이 쑤시는 진짜 이유
비 오기 전날부터 쑤신다 / 날씨와 무릎 통증

image_concepts.A: 맑은데 먹구름이 몰려오는 창가, 무릎을 짚고 찡그린 할머니
image_concepts.B: 우산 펼친 무릎 + 먹구름 아래 통증으로 놀란 사람

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A. 거실 창가, 무릎을 두 손으로 짚고 찡그린 60대 할머니. 창밖 하늘은 아직 파란데 한쪽에서 먹구름이 몰려온다. 탁자 위엔 접은 우산.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail in a bright Korean living room. An anonymous Korean grandmother in her late 60s with a kind face clutches her knee with both hands, grimacing in exaggerated pain, her upper body large in the center of the frame with a crisp cutout look and strong rim light, a soft red glow around her knee. Through the big window behind her the sky is still blue and sunny, but a dark heavy storm cloud is rolling in from one side. A folded umbrella leans on the table beside her. Realistic colors, intriguing mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 A 변형. 아파트 계단을 내려가다 무릎을 잡고 멈춘 60대 남성, 계단 창밖으로 몰려오는 먹구름.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail on an apartment staircase. An anonymous Korean man in his 60s with a warm likeable face stops mid-step, gripping his knee with an exaggerated wince, his upper body large on the left of the frame with a crisp cutout look and rim light, a red glow on the knee. Through the stairwell window on the right, dark storm clouds gather over a still-bright city sky. Realistic textures, high contrast, curious mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B. 화면 가득 큰 무릎 위로 작은 우산이 씌워져 있고, 그 위에 먹구름이 떠 있다. 옆에서 놀란 표정으로 무릎을 보는 사람.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail with playful humor: an oversized human knee fills the center of the frame, glowing red with pain, and a tiny umbrella is propped over it while a small dark rain cloud hovers just above. On the right, an anonymous Korean woman in her 50s with a warm likeable face stares at her own knee in exaggerated surprise, crisp cutout look with rim light. Bright sky-blue background, vivid realistic colors.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 컨셉 B 변형. 비 오는 날 우산을 쓴 채 무릎을 붙잡고 한쪽 다리를 든 할아버지, 빗방울과 웅덩이.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail on a rainy street. An anonymous Korean grandfather in his 70s with a kind face holds an umbrella in one hand and grabs his knee with the other, lifting one leg with an exaggerated pained expression, his upper body large in the center with a crisp cutout look and rim light, a red glow on the knee. Raindrops, puddles and gray clouds fill the background. Realistic colors, slightly humorous mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 와일드카드(대본 처방). 무릎에 찜질팩을 올리고 휴대폰 날씨 앱의 비 예보를 확인하며 놀란 할머니, 옆엔 우산.
thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic composite thumbnail in a cozy Korean living room. An anonymous Korean grandmother in her late 60s with a warm likeable face sits on a sofa with a warm heating pad wrapped around her knee, holding up a smartphone and staring at it in exaggerated surprise, her upper body large on the left with a crisp cutout look and rim light. A folded umbrella leans beside her, and through the window on the right dark rain clouds approach. Bright warm lighting, vivid realistic colors, humorous mood.
